title: Calico capture status (v1)
description: Closed, row-free positive projection every calico_capture.orchestrator.capture() call returns (06-01-PLAN.md D-08/D-09; 06-02-PLAN.md D-08/D-09; 06-RESEARCH.md 'Safe status projection'). Every field is explicitly assigned from a fixed, already-safe vocabulary or a safe release-identity value at construction -- never derived by copying a private admission/archive result and then deleting or masking suspect fields. Contains no fingerprint, path, URL, message, exception type, object/row count, actor/job name, credential, or source artifact. This is the sole schema a caller validates a status document against before writing it to stdout, a GitHub Actions job summary, or the dedicated published-data branch.

trigger.description: Which of the three closed entry points invoked this capture attempt (D-06). Safe workflow metadata -- never a job name, run id, or actor identity.

outcome.description: The existing closed calico_landing.result.AdmissionResult outcome vocabulary, reused verbatim (D-07).

reason_category.description: A fixed, provider-neutral reason category -- never a raw exception string, path, or credential fragment.

started_at_utc.description: Timezone-aware actual UTC timestamp captured once at the start of this capture() call.

ended_at_utc.description: Timezone-aware actual UTC timestamp captured once this call's outcome was decided.

last_accepted_as_of_date.description: The as-of date of the release this attempt confirms as accepted, populated only for the accepted/no_new_release outcomes; null for every rejected/operational_error outcome -- this attempt never advances or echoes a stale value on failure.

last_accepted_release_revision.description: The release revision of the same accepted/no_new_release release identity; null for every rejected/operational_error outcome.
